vagas.descriptionPlain:
Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions.
Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy. 
Somos 8.000 CI&Ters em mais de 25 países, colaborando para construir soluções com impacto real. AI já faz parte da forma como trabalhamos, evoluímos e inovamos todos os dias.
Importante: se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.


Buscamos uma pessoa com forte experiência técnica, autonomia para resolver problemas complexos e interesse em desenvolver soluções inovadoras com Inteligência Artificial.
Esperamos alguém que tenha experiência prática na construção de agentes inteligentes, skills e soluções de IA, boa comunicação e facilidade para colaborar com diferentes times. Curiosidade, protagonismo e vontade de aprender também fazem parte desse desafio!
Sua missão
Atuar como referência técnica na construção e evolução de soluções de IA e automação, contribuindo diretamente para a produtividade, qualidade informacional e evolução das plataformas que suportam o negócio.
Principais responsabilidades
Desenvolver agentes inteligentes e skills para apoiar processos de curadoria, publicação e gestão de conteúdo.
Construir integrações entre plataformas, APIs e serviços corporativos.
Evoluir taxonomias e ferramentas de leitura, classificação e análise de conversas.
Desenvolver soluções de IA voltadas à produtividade e disponibilização de novas capacidades para o negócio.
Atuar com autonomia na identificação de problemas, definição de soluções e implementação técnica.
Contribuir com iniciativas de qualidade informacional, agentes inteligentes e evolução da base de conhecimento.
O que esperamos de você:
Experiência com desenvolvimento Java.
Experiência prática na criação e implementação de agentes inteligentes e skills.
Conhecimento em APIs REST, incluindo design, consumo e integração.
Experiência na avaliação da qualidade de soluções com LLMs, incluindo evals, guardrails e observabilidade (tracing, custos e latência).
Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços e integração entre sistemas, utilizando filas e eventos.
Experiência com Git para versionamento e colaboração em código.
Boa comunicação, autonomia e facilidade de colaboração com o time.
Será um diferencial:
Experiência com frameworks de agentes, como LangChain, LangGraph ou CrewAI, e protocolos como MCP e tool calling.
Experiência com LLMs aplicados à classificação, extração e análise de conversas e textos, incluindo construção e evolução de taxonomias.
Conhecimento em práticas DevOps, infraestrutura como código (IaC) e containers.
Se você gosta de desafios técnicos, inovação e construção de soluções inteligentes com impacto real no negócio, queremos conhecer você!

We are looking for a Senior Data Visualisation Engineer with strong knowledge in developing and maintaining data ingestion pipelines and integrating data from various sources, such as APIs, relational databases, files, and many others!
 
Position Overview
Design, build, and optimize semantic data models in Tableau to support self-service analytics and enterprise reporting.
Develop, maintain, and optimize Tableau dashboards, reports, and datasets, ensuring accuracy, usability, and performance.
Partner with data engineering teams to define and validate data pipelines in Databricks and ensure seamless integration with BI models.
Collaborate with  multifunctional teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable BI solutions.
Drive the migration strategy from Looker to Databricks + Tableau, ensuring minimal disruption and high adoption.
Implement best practices in data governance, performance optimization, and security for BI assets.
Ensure the quality and integrity of data used for decision-making.
Identify and resolve data and dashboard performance issues.
Familiarity with Looker for data visualization, reporting, and analytics is highly desirable but not essential.
 
Must Haves
Proven experience in developing dashboards in Tableau.
Consolidated experience with Data Visualisation.
Solid knowledge of SQL and manipulation of large volumes of data.
Solid foundation in Dimensional Data Modelling.
Familiarity with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) methodologies and data integration tools.
Ability to analyse and interpret complex data to generate clear and understandable reports.
Advanced English is essential.

We are seeking a highly skilled Master Software Developer with a strong background in backend architecture and experience in integrating generative AI tools into client products. The ideal candidate will have proficiency in Python, C# or Java, thrive in a complex work environment with multiple stakeholders, and possess excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with both team members and clients. Fluency in English is essential for daily interactions and intensive discussions.

Key Responsibilities:
Backend Development: Design, implement, and maintain robust and scalable backend architecture using Python.
Generative AI Integration: Leverage generative AI technologies to enhance client products, providing innovative solutions and tools. 
Knowledge on Generative AI technical stacks and strategies (LLMs, RAG, Fine Tunning, Chain of Thought, etc.) and how to embed them into client’s products.
Client Communication: Engage with clients to understand their requirements, provide regular updates, and gather feedback to refine product features.
Code Quality and Best Practices: Ensure code maintainability, readability, and performance by adhering to best practices and conducting code reviews.
Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for backend services and generative AI integrations.

Qualifications:
Education: 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in development using Python, C# or Java.  
Proven experience in backend architecture design and implementation.  
Familiarity with generative AI technologies and their application in product development.

Technical Skills:  
Proficient in Python  
Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and database management (SQL and NoSQL).  
Experience with cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).  
Knowledge of machine learning concepts and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) is a plus.

Soft Skills:  
Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (both written and verbal).  -

The ideal candidate will have proficiency in Python, C# or Java, thrive in a complex work environment with multiple stakeholders, and possess excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with both team members and clients. Fluency in English is essential for daily interactions and intensive discussions.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Backend Development: Design, implement, and maintain robust and scalable backend architecture using Python.
Generative AI Integration: Leverage generative AI technologies to enhance client products, providing innovative solutions and tools.
Knowledge on Generative AI technical stacks and strategies (LLMs, RAG, Fine Tunning, Chain of Thought, etc.) and how to embed them into client’s products.
Client Communication: Engage with clients to understand their requirements, provide regular updates, and gather feedback to refine product features.
Code Quality and Best Practices: Ensure code maintainability, readability, and performance by adhering to best practices and conducting code reviews.
Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for backend services and generative AI integrations.
 
Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in development using Python, C# or Java.  
Proven experience in backend architecture design and implementation.  
Familiarity with generative AI technologies and their application in product development.
 
Technical Skills:  
Proficient in Python  
Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and database management (SQL and NoSQL).  
Experience with cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).  
Knowledge of machine learning concepts and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) is a plus.
 
Soft Skills:  
Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (both written and verbal).  -

vagas.descriptionPlain:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


We're looking for a Senior Client Director to join our expanding EMEA region to act as the commercial leader of a portfolio of strategic client accounts that is responsible for accelerating the profitable growth by expanding engagements, relationships & measurable business value. 
 
This role will act as the CEO of the accounts, giving autonomy to grow & run the accounts by planning & executing the strategy to embed themselves by bringing together the technology strategy, delivery, data, AI, marketing, partnerships & new business.
 
This position will require you to be onsite in CI&T's London office/client's offices a minimum of 3 days a week, depending on client need.
 
The Key Responsibilities of this role are:
 
Own the Account Strategy
Develop & execute strategic account growth plans aligned the the clients and CI&T's objectives
Lead the client Strategy Group
Act as commercial owner across a portfolio of strategic accounts
Drive the Commercial Growth
Deliver 20%+ year on year growth across your accounts
Lead commercial strategy & solutions
Partner with the new business director around a shared growth plan
Build Executive Relationships
Establish trusted relationships across C-Suite & senior stakeholders
Lead business reviews, strategic governance & transformation discussions
Develop deep client intelligence to shape long term engagements
Champion Delivery Excellence
Own the overall commercial performance, forecasting and profitability on your portfolio
Build efficient partnerships with the delivery leaders to ensure the programmes deliver measurable business outcomes
Act as the escalation point for client engagements
Lead Collaboration
Bring together CI&T's teams to build solutions to complex issues within the client
Coordinate executive engagements and thought leadership
Share market insights with the wider team
 
What we're looking for:
Strong commercial experience within a technology consultancy or similar with a proven track record of growing accounts and delivering measurable year on year growth
Confident in stakeholder management to C-level
Expert in recognising opportunities, qualifying them and strategically planning accounts
Ability to connect business insights to strategic growth
Excellent presentation skills and object handling
Experienced in working with nearshore and offshore delivery teams
Can lead complex, global technology and business change for critical enterprise platforms

About the Role
We’re looking for an experienced and commercially minded Senior HR Business Partner to join our People & Culture team and partner closely with senior leaders across EMEA.
This is a high-impact, hands-on role for an HR professional who thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments and enjoys operating at both a strategic and operational level. You’ll play a key role in translating business priorities into people strategies that enable growth, strengthen organisational culture and deliver measurable business outcomes.
With teams across the UK, Portugal and Brazil, you’ll bring a strong understanding of working across different cultures and markets, while helping the organisation navigate transformation and change.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence leadership decisions, shape organisational design, develop talent and succession pipelines, strengthen performance management, and lead initiatives that enhance the overall employee experience.
What You’ll Do
Partner with Senior Leadership
Act as a trusted strategic partner to senior leaders across EMEA, providing insight and challenge on people, organisational structure, performance and workforce matters.
Translate business strategy and evolving priorities into practical People & Culture solutions.
Support leaders in making informed, people-focused decisions in a fast-moving environment.
Drive People Strategy & Transformation
Develop and deliver People & Culture initiatives that directly support business objectives and deliver measurable impact.
Lead and contribute to organisational transformation and change initiatives across the region.
Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, policies and ways of working, ensuring they remain agile and fit for purpose.
Lead Core HR Processes
Own and support end-to-end workforce planning and headcount management.
Drive succession planning and talent development pipelines.
Lead performance management cycles, including calibration and development planning.
Support employee engagement, culture and organisational effectiveness initiatives.
Use Data to Drive Decisions
Leverage people analytics and HR metrics to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
Turn data and insights into clear recommendations for leaders.
Use evidence-based approaches to continuously improve people processes and employee experience across diverse teams.
Coach & Develop Leaders
Provide hands-on coaching to leaders on effective people management, feedback, performance, conflict resolution and leadership development.
Help leaders build high-performing, inclusive teams and foster a culture of open communication and continuous improvement.
Collaborate Across People & Culture
Work closely with Talent Acquisition, People Development, Compensation & Benefits and Culture teams.
Ensure HR policies, programmes and practices are aligned, consistent and responsive to the needs of the business and our people.
What We’re Looking For
You’ll bring:
Proven experience in an HR Business Partner, People Partner or strategic HR role, ideally within an organisation experiencing significant growth, transformation or change.
A strong track record of partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
A hands-on approach, with the ability to move confidently between strategic thinking and operational delivery.
Strong experience across performance management, talent development, succession planning and organisational culture.
Excellent commercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people solutions.
Experience working across different countries, cultures and organisational contexts within EMEA.
A strong analytical mindset, with experience using people data, HR metrics and reporting to inform decisions and improve processes.
Exceptional communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
The ability to build trusted relationships at all levels and confidently challenge and coach senior leaders.
A proven ability to operate effectively through ambiguity, change and evolving organisational priorities.
Nice to Have
Experience working within a technology, startup or high-growth environment.
Experience leading organisational transformation or change management initiatives across multiple regions.
Knowledge of Portuguese would be an advantage.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Service Designer to join our Strategy & Foundations team for a 6-month fixed-term contract. You will be embedded in a product program for one of the world's leading dealership management software providers, collaborating closely with a talented team including a Digital Strategist, User Researcher, UX Designer, and Technical Architect.

As a Service Designer, you will map end-to-end service experiences across a complex multi-product ecosystem. Your focus will be on creating service blueprints that encompass customer-facing touchpoints and back-stage operational workflows. You will identify systemic pain points, root causes, and opportunities that will inform product prioritization directly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design Service Blueprints: Develop and maintain comprehensive service blueprints that outline user touchpoints, internal processes, and back-stage dealership systems.
  • Identify Inefficiencies: Analyze operational gaps and inefficiencies between customer interactions and internal workflows.
  • Synthesize Insights: Combine research findings, stakeholder input, and operational data into clear service models and prioritization recommendations.
  • Facilitate Workshops: Lead cross-functional workshops with operational teams and senior leadership to foster collaboration and innovation.
  • Actionable Recommendations: Translate blueprint findings into practical recommendations for product and strategy leads.
  • Collaborative Approach: Work closely with UX Designers and Technical Architects to ensure that your findings are grounded in user realities and implementation constraints.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven Expertise: Demonstrated experience as a Service Designer, showcasing a portfolio that highlights service blueprinting and systems thinking in complex environments.
  • Strong Facilitation Skills: Experience in conducting workshops with operational and executive stakeholders.
  • Analytical Synthesis: Ability to distill ambiguous, multi-source information into actionable service maps.
  • Team Collaboration: Comfortable working within cross-functional teams alongside researchers, designers, and technologists.
  • User Engagement: Confident in engaging directly with end users and business stakeholders to uncover latent needs and pain points.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional written and visual communication skills, capable of presenting strategic recommendations to senior audiences.
  • Outcomes-Focused: Ability to differentiate between documentation that drives decisions and that which serves no purpose.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or complex back-office product environments.
  • Familiarity with automotive retail, dealership operations, or fleet management.
  • Proficiency in tools such as Miro, Figma, Confluence, or Lucidchart.
  • Experience working in agile delivery environments alongside product managers and engineers.

Location

This position is based in the UK, with regular trips to CI&T's UK office in London and also to client site.

Estamos em busca de um desenvolvedor Java Master/Sênior para atuar em grande frente junto a AWS, você irá construir as camadas de capacidade de negócio de uma plataforma bancária moderna, centralizando regras de negócio e autorização que hoje vivem espalhadas em sistemas legados. Você vai desenvolver microsserviços de domínio que unificam a lógica transacional, implementar padrões de integração (adapters) para conectar o ambiente legado à nova plataforma e garantir, através de validações de equivalência e reconciliação, que a migração aconteça sem qualquer regressão. Ideal para quem gosta de modelar domínios complexos e entregar backend confiável em cenários onde consistência e compliance são inegociáveis.

Desenvolvimento backend em Java (Spring Boot ou equivalente) para microsserviços de domínio.
Implementação de motores de regras de negócio e de autorização.
Padrões de integração (adapter / anti-corruption layer) entre sistemas legado e plataformas modernas.
Deploy em Kubernetes/EKS e desenvolvimento de fluxos transacionais.
Testes de equivalência, reconciliação e validação de carga.
Conhecimentos em:
AWS (EKS, ECR).
Padrões de arquitetura do setor financeiro (ex.: BIAN).
Compliance e trilhas de auditoria no setor financeiro.
Integração com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL.
Diferencial:
Certificações AWS: AWS Certified Developer – Associate e/ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate."

As CI&T grows its Data & Analytics Center of Excellence, we seek a talented and experienced Graph Database Developer to join a specialized team building an AI-powered fashion advisory platform for a leading client in the fashion and retail industry. This role is central to turning unstructured editorial content into a structured knowledge graph that powers real-time, intelligent style recommendations for end users attending formal events.
The Graph Database Developer will work in a staff augmentation model, integrating with a cross-functional team that includes a Machine Learning Developer and a GenAI Agent Developer. This is a hands-on technical position requiring strong ownership of the graph data layer — from schema design through ingestion, entity resolution, and query performance — with direct impact on what the AI agent recommends to users.
Responsibilities:
Schema Design: Define node labels and edge types that represent the relationships between designers, garments, style attributes, trends, occasions, and editorial articles.
Entity Ingestion: Build workflows that consume structured JSON payloads from the upstream data pipeline and load them into the graph database in batch mode.
Probabilistic Entity Matching: Match extracted item mentions (for example, a bag described by type, color, and material) to the correct product node in a catalog of 50,000+ SKUs by scoring attribute overlap, assigning a match confidence, and creating the relationship only when it exceeds a defined threshold. Deduplicate items that appear inconsistently across different articles.

CI&T is looking for a Senior Data Architect specialized in integrations to join a modernization initiative for a leading client in the digital commerce industry. This is a strategic role: the person hired will be the technical reference responsible for unifying data across core business systems — ERP, CRM, finance, and inventory management — and the client's customer-facing platform, ensuring that critical information, such as revenue figures, flows consistently and reliably across the entire operation.
The scope of this position covers the full integration lifecycle: from architecture design to implementation, governance, and continuous optimization of data flows. The role combines deep technical expertise in the integration platform with a data governance mindset, and includes direct collaboration with enterprise architects, product owners, and ERP functional consultants to translate business needs into robust, scalable integration solutions.
Responsibilities:
Designs and documents end-to-end integration architecture, defining real-time, batch, and event-driven communication patterns across legacy systems, e-commerce platforms, SaaS ecosystems, and microservices.
Develops and optimizes integration flows between the integration platform and the client's ERP, leveraging native connectors and multiple connection points to ensure reliable data synchronization.
Defines development best practices, naming standards, and component reuse, ensuring consistency and maintainability across integration teams.
Establishes centralized logging, auditing, and exception-handling strategies, enabling full traceability of business-critical data flows.
Performs infrastructure sizing for the integration platform, optimizing concurrency, rate limiting, and resource consumption to ensure performance at scale.
Manages the promotion of integration processes across environments (development, QA, and production) and version control, through structured deployment practices.
Provides technical leadership to the development team by conducting code reviews and mentoring, ensuring adherence to the organization's architecture guidelines.
Collaborates directly with product owners, enterprise architects, and ERP functional specialists to map data requirements and translate them into efficient integration flows.
Assesses and proposes the inclusion of master data governance practices within the integration architecture, preventing discrepancies in business-critical metrics.
Requirements:
Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise integration architectures (middleware, ESB, or iPaaS).
Deep, hands-on expertise with the Boomi integration platform (AtomSphere, API Management, Atom/Molecule, EDI/B2B) — mandatory requirement.

At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


As CI&T grows its Data & Analytics Center of Excellence, we seek a talented and experienced Graph Database Developer to join a specialized team building an AI-powered fashion advisory platform for a leading client in the fashion and retail industry. This role is central to turning unstructured editorial content into a structured knowledge graph that powers real-time, intelligent style recommendations for end users attending formal events.
The Graph Database Developer will work in a staff augmentation model, integrating with a cross-functional team that includes a Machine Learning Developer and a GenAI Agent Developer. This is a hands-on technical position requiring strong ownership of the graph data layer — from schema design through ingestion, entity resolution, and query performance — with direct impact on what the AI agent recommends to users.
Responsibilities:
Schema Design: Define node labels and edge types that represent the relationships between designers, garments, style attributes, trends, occasions, and editorial articles.
Entity Ingestion: Build workflows that consume structured JSON payloads from the upstream data pipeline and load them into the graph database in batch mode.
Probabilistic Entity Matching: Match extracted item mentions (for example, a bag described by type, color, and material) to the correct product node in a catalog of 50,000+ SKUs by scoring attribute overlap, assigning a match confidence, and creating the relationship only when it exceeds a defined threshold. Deduplicate items that appear inconsistently across different articles.
Editorial Signal Weighting: Assign weights to relationships based on how prominently an item or trend was featured, distinguishing a dedicated feature from a passing mention. These weights determine what the AI agent surfaces first in its recommendations.
Query Optimization: Design and tune openCypher traversal queries, including multi-hop queries, to return relevant results in under three seconds for downstream Amazon Bedrock Agents.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside the Machine Learning Developer and GenAI Agent Developer to align the graph structure with the retrieval and recommendation needs of the AI agent.
Technical Validation: Support technical interviews and validation of new team members joining the graph database workstream, as needed.
Requirements:
Advanced English proficiency (C1 or above), with autonomy to communicate directly with international stakeholders
Solid experience with the property graph data model
Experience writing and optimizing openCypher queries, including multi-hop traversals under latency constraints
Experience designing graph schemas, evaluating trade-offs between different modeling approaches
Experience building entity resolution logic, including fuzzy matching, scoring algorithms, and deduplication across data sources
Strong Python skills for data engineering, including batch processing of structured data payloads
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, staff augmentation setting with an established client team
 
Nice to Have:
Solid experience with Amazon Neptune
Prior experience in fashion, retail, or e-commerce catalogs
AWS certification in databases or data analytics
Experience integrating graph databases with generative AI agents (for example, Amazon Bedrock Agents)
Familiarity with recommendation systems or ranking/weighting logic for content surfacing
 
#LI-JP3
vagas.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


You will own the technical direction of the platform's agent SDK (`florence-agentic-ai`) and its framework adapters, the agent and MCP templates, and the runtime contract every agent on the platform depends on.

You decide what the SDK's public API is, how it changes without breaking dozens of teams, and how safety behaviors (loop guards, retry ownership, failure codes, delegation limits) hold the same way across Strands, Claude Agent SDK and LangGraph, over HTTP and A2A.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the SDK as a product: public API, semantic versioning, deprecation policy, migration guides and release hygiene (builds you can reproduce, bounded dependencies, publishing from `main` only).
  • Design and evolve the adapter and host contracts so that agents behave the same whatever the framework (Strands, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph) or deployment target (AgentCore Runtime, AgentCore Harness, ECS Fargate).
  • Lead multi-agent orchestration patterns: supervisor/worker and planner/executor/verifier designs, declared-peer delegation, A2A protocol support, and ending agent loops by design. Build runtime safety into the SDK: call-chain and hop limits, session cycle budgets, timeouts, per-peer circuit breakers, structured failures that alerts can page on.
  • Define the extension model (hooks, per-request settings, escape hatches) and turn repeated escape-hatch use into supported features.
  • Own the parity and contract test suite that gates every SDK and template release.
  • Lead design reviews and RCAs. Turn incidents into lasting platform controls, not one-off fixes.
  • Act as the leader of the teama and also mentor engineers 
  • Split large refactors into parallel tracks and deliver against fixed release dates.
 

Requirements:

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or above), with autonomy to communicate directly with international stakeholders
  • Extensive years of professional experiecne with software engineering and leading teams
  • Experience building libraries, SDKs or platforms used by other engineering teams.
  • Expert Python (async, typing, packaging, dependency management, pytest at scale).
  • Hands-on production experience building LLM agents with at least one of: Strands Agents, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI or similar.
  • You understand the agent loop: tool calling, context management, turn limits, streaming. Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients, and with agent-to-agent communication (A2A or equivalent).
  • Track record of managing breaking changes in a widely used internal or open-source library: versioning, compatibility shims, migration tooling.
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals: timeouts, retries, idempotency, circuit breakers, backpressure, failure propagation.
  • AWS experience, ideally Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Gateway, Memory, Identity).
  • Clear technical writing: design docs, ADRs, migration guides.

 

Nice to Have:

  • AWS certifications and recent study/project history in agent technology will be accepted in lieu of multiple years of hands-on experience. 

 
 #LI-LO1

You will build and maintain the core components teams use to ship agents: the Python SDK, agent and MCP templates, memory and context services, the agent registry integration and the FastAPI entry layer. You will often own one component end to end, as primary support.

Responsibilities:

  • Build SDK features and framework adapters (Strands, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph), including memory (AgentCore Memory short- and long-term, Redis), skills, prompt management integration, and evaluation hooks.
  • Build and maintain agent and MCP server templates for AgentCore Runtime and ECS Fargate, over HTTP and A2A.
  • Integrate with the AWS Agent Registry: registration, approval flow, identity-scoped discovery. Build and support RAG and knowledge services (Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch vector, ingestion pipelines).
  • Write contract and integration tests.
  • Keep the release parity gate green.
  • Help use-case teams onboard, debug their agents, and feed what you learn back into the platform.
  • Take part in on-call or office hours, and in RCAs.

Requirements:

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or above), with autonomy to communicate directly with international stakeholders
  • Extensive years of experience in software engineering, with strong Python: FastAPI or similar, async, packaging, testing.
  • 1+ year building LLM-powered applications or agents that reached real users (pilot or production).
  • Experience with tool calling, prompt design and handling model failures.
  • Familiarity with at least one agent framework (Strands, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, LlamaIndex).
  • AWS experience: Lambda, ECS/Fargate, IAM, S3, DynamoDB, and Bedrock or SageMaker.
  • Experience with RAG: embeddings, vector stores, chunking and retrieval tuning.
  • Comfortable with CI/CD, containers (Docker) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred). Preferred Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Harness, Gateway, Memory, Identity, Code Interpreter). MCP server development.
  • A2A protocol. Redis/ElastiCache, OpenSearch. Langfuse or similar LLM observability, prompt management and evaluation tools.
  • Experience writing internal developer documentation and samples (notebooks, quick starts).

Nice to Have:

  • AWS certifications and recent study/project history in agent technology will be accepted in lieu of multiple years of hands-on experience.

  • Integrate with the AWS Agent Registry: registration, approval flow, identity-scoped discovery. Build and support RAG and knowledge services (Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch vector, ingestion pipelines).
  • Write contract and integration tests.
  • Keep the release parity gate green.
  • Help use-case teams onboard, debug their agents, and feed what you learn back into the platform.
  • Take part in on-call or office hours, and in RCAs.

Requirements:

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or above), with autonomy to communicate directly with international stakeholders
  • Extensive years of experience in software engineering, with strong Python: FastAPI or similar, async, packaging, testing.
  • 1+ year building LLM-powered applications or agents that reached real users (pilot or production).
  • Experience with tool calling, prompt design and handling model failures.
  • Familiarity with at least one agent framework (Strands, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, LlamaIndex).
  • AWS experience: Lambda, ECS/Fargate, IAM, S3, DynamoDB, and Bedrock or SageMaker.
  • Experience with RAG: embeddings, vector stores, chunking and retrieval tuning.
  • Comfortable with CI/CD, containers (Docker) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred). Preferred Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Harness, Gateway, Memory, Identity, Code Interpreter). MCP server development.
  • A2A protocol. Redis/ElastiCache, OpenSearch. Langfuse or similar LLM observability, prompt management and evaluation tools.
  • Experience writing internal developer documentation and samples (notebooks, quick starts).

Nice to Have:

  • AWS certifications and recent study/project history in agent technology will be accepted in lieu of multiple years of hands-on experience.

vagas.descriptionBodyPlain:
As CI&T grows its Data & Analytics Center of Excellence, we seek a talented and experienced Graph Database Developer to join a specialized team building an AI-powered fashion advisory platform for a leading client in the fashion and retail industry. This role is central to turning unstructured editorial content into a structured knowledge graph that powers real-time, intelligent style recommendations for end users attending formal events.
The Graph Database Developer will work in a staff augmentation model, integrating with a cross-functional team that includes a Machine Learning Developer and a GenAI Agent Developer. This is a hands-on technical position requiring strong ownership of the graph data layer — from schema design through ingestion, entity resolution, and query performance — with direct impact on what the AI agent recommends to users.
Responsibilities:
Schema Design: Define node labels and edge types that represent the relationships between designers, garments, style attributes, trends, occasions, and editorial articles.
Entity Ingestion: Build workflows that consume structured JSON payloads from the upstream data pipeline and load them into the graph database in batch mode.
Probabilistic Entity Matching: Match extracted item mentions (for example, a bag described by type, color, and material) to the correct product node in a catalog of 50,000+ SKUs by scoring attribute overlap, assigning a match confidence, and creating the relationship only when it exceeds a defined threshold. Deduplicate items that appear inconsistently across different articles.
Editorial Signal Weighting: Assign weights to relationships based on how prominently an item or trend was featured, distinguishing a dedicated feature from a passing mention. These weights determine what the AI agent surfaces first in its recommendations.
Query Optimization: Design and tune openCypher traversal queries, including multi-hop queries, to return relevant results in under three seconds for downstream Amazon Bedrock Agents.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside the Machine Learning Developer and GenAI Agent Developer to align the graph structure with the retrieval and recommendation needs of the AI agent.
Technical Validation: Support technical interviews and validation of new team members joining the graph database workstream, as needed.
Requirements:
Advanced English proficiency (C1 or above), with autonomy to communicate directly with international stakeholders
Solid experience with the property graph data model
Experience writing and optimizing openCypher queries, including multi-hop traversals under latency constraints
Experience designing graph schemas, evaluating trade-offs between different modeling approaches
Experience building entity resolution logic, including fuzzy matching, scoring algorithms, and deduplication across data sources
Strong Python skills for data engineering, including batch processing of structured data payloads
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, staff augmentation setting with an established client team
 
Nice to Have:
Solid experience with Amazon Neptune
Prior experience in fashion, retail, or e-commerce catalogs
AWS certification in databases or data analytics
Experience integrating graph databases with generative AI agents (for example, Amazon Bedrock Agents)
Familiarity with recommendation systems or ranking/weighting logic for content surfacing

Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions.

Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy. 

Somos 8.000 CI&Ters em mais de 25 países, colaborando para construir soluções com impacto real. AI já faz parte da forma como trabalhamos, evoluímos e inovamos todos os dias.

Importante: se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

Olá, aqui é a Tamara da CI&T!
 

Estamos à procura de um engenheiro de dados qualificado para se juntar à nossa equipe, com experiência em soluções de dados na AWS. O candidato será responsável por projetar e otimizar pipelines de dados.

Nesta função, você será responsável por projetar, otimizar e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis na nuvem AWS, além de trabalhar na fronteira de inovação com GenAI e arquiteturas avançadas de dados.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Migração e Arquitetura: Planejar e executar a migração de sistemas e volumes de dados para a nova infraestrutura em nuvem;

  • Engenharia de ETL/ELT: Desenvolver, otimizar e orquestrar processos de ETL/ELT garantindo a integridade, performance e qualidade dos dados;

  • Colaboração e Operação: Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes multidisciplinares (desenvolvimento, produtos e operações) para implementar soluções de dados eficientes;

  • Monitoramento e Suporte: Acompanhar a saúde dos ambientes, solucionar problemas complexos em bancos de dados/pipelines e atuar na melhoria contínua;

  • Documentação e Governança: Criar e manter a documentação técnica (arquitetura, lineage e processos de dados).

Requisitos Necessários (Hard Skills):

  • Experiência com AWS: Domínio de ecossistema de dados AWS (AWS Glue, EMR, Amazon Athena, DynamoDB, Lake Formation, Amazon S3, EventBridge);

  • Processamento e Arquitetura de Dados: Sólida experiência em Apache Spark / PySpark, modelagem de Data Warehouse (Amazon Redshift), Lakehouse, Open Table Formats (Iceberg/Delta), data contract e schema evolution;

  • Orquestração e Bancos de Dados: Prática com Apache Airflow e sólida experiência em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL) e não relacionais (NoSQL);

  • Governança e Monitoramento: Conhecimento em governança de dados, data lineage (OpenLineage) e ferramentas de observabilidade (CloudWatch ou DataDog);

  • Soft Skills e Práticas: Cultura DevOps, mentalidade de automação, capacidade de planejamento de capacidade (trade-offs entre custo x performance), resolução de incidentes e melhoria contínua.

Diferenciais:

  • IA Generativa e Novas Tecnologias: Vivência com Amazon Bedrock, MCP Server, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Embeddings, Guardrails, Eval e Spec Driven Development;

  • Migração e Legacy Systems: Conhecimento prévio em ferramentas SAS e histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de grande porte;

  • Certificações: Certificações ativas em AWS ou plataformas de dados correlatas.

At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


About the opportunity
We are looking for a Tech Lead/Architect (.NET + Azure) to join an international project. In this role, you will be the technical leader of the team: a highly experienced professional who guides technical direction, solves problems together with the team, and is able to implement solutions when needed. We want someone who enjoys sharing knowledge and contributing to CI&T and the community. We value cultural fit, respect for differences, collaboration, and teamwork.
 
What your day-to-day will look like
As the technical leader of the team, you will be responsible for:
Being an accessible technical reference for the developers, QA, and support teams, assisting and guiding them whenever they need support
Getting hands-on and implementing solutions when needed, especially when the team requires support to deliver changes
Leading the technical response to severe production incidents, from diagnosis to verified resolution
Guiding architectural and technical decisions, documenting the significant ones, to keep the solution scalable, secure, and sustainable
Solving complex problems together with the team, bringing the right people together to find the best solution
Reviewing technical solutions and promoting good programming and architecture practices
Helping keep the backlog well-defined and taking part in refinement sessions
Driving continuous improvements on an established solution
Keeping code quality and security findings visible and remediated within agreed SLAs
Defining and evolving technical standards
Following .NET and Azure trends and bringing in the ones that make sense for the project
Partnering with DevOps on application changes that affect operations
Communicating in English with the client’s technical experts when needed
Translating business needs into technical options and decisions
 
What you should have
Strong, in-depth experience in C# and modern .NET versions, including ASP.NET Core MVC Razor
Working knowledge of Azure and DevOps practices, enough to partner with DevOps on application changes that affect operations
High level of seniority, still hands-on and able to implement solutions
Experience in guiding teams and driving technical decisions
Proven ability to solve complex problems collaboratively, involving the right people and sharing the challenge with the team instead of working in isolation
Leadership soft skills to align people, encourage collaboration, and drive solutions together
Experience driving continuous improvements and technical standards
Experience with databases, version control, cloud, and CI/CD tools
Experience with automated testing, code review practices, and static analysis tools, including remediating code quality and security findings
Experience troubleshooting production issues and handling incidents
Good judgment to prioritize and to raise technical risks early
Experience or ability to work with development, QA, and support activities
Excellent communication skills, both technical and business-related, including clear written documentation
Advanced or fluent English

Data Collection and Analysis:
Develop and maintain data dashboards.
Data Modeling and Visualization.
Generate clear and informative data visualizations, charts, and reports using QuickSight or similar tools.
Present findings to stakeholders in a comprehensible manner.

Data Quality Assurance:
Ensure data integrity and quality by identifying and rectifying data discrepancies and errors.

Collaboration:
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and provide data-driven insights and recommendations.

Documentation:
Maintain comprehensive documentation of data analysis processes, methodologies, and results.
Validate dimensional data models align with business reporting needs.
Perform data quality validation and reconciliation between source systems and warehouse.
Design and build Power BI dashboards.
Develop consolidated reporting for different stakeholders.
Create operational KPIs and business performance metrics.
Work directly with finance and delivery stakeholders to gather requirements.
Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership.

Requirements for this challenge:

Familiarity with AI engagements and Agentic coding.
Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science).
Solid experience as a Data Analyst 
Advanced SQL for data validation and ad hoc analysis (required); Python optional.
Expert-level Power BI (complex executive dashboards, DAX).
Azure SQL Database and data warehouse querying.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication skills with the ability to convey complex findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Understanding of dimensional data models (star schema, fact/dimension tables).
Experience with financial reporting and analysis (P&L, operational KPIs, financial and delivery metrics).
Direct experience working with executive stakeholders.
Ability to translate business requirements into reporting solutions.
Knowledge of database management systems and data warehousing.
Advanced English.

Experience with data cleansing, transformation, and integration.
Familiarity with statistical analysis and data modeling techniques is a plus.

As CI&T grows, we seek a talented, motivated, and experienced Data Product Manager to join our Global Offerings and Operations team and lead data-driven solutions. This role is pivotal in balancing strategic management with hands-on execution, ensuring our data initiatives are not only well planned but also effectively implemented.
 
The Data Product Manager will oversee the entire lifecycle of data products, from ideation and development to deployment and optimization. This position requires a unique blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, critical analysis, and leadership skills to drive the successful execution of data-driven initiatives while actively participating in day-to-day operations. You will be responsible for the tracking strategy of our Global Offerings and Operations area. It will require your ability to translate behavior metrics into business insights and data visualizations that feed and drive the initiatives.
 
Responsibilities:
 
Data Analysis: Provide data analysis that supports business and digital product growth through data visualization.
Team Leadership: Lead cross-functional teams, including data scientists, engineers, and analytics specialists, to develop and deliver high-quality data products. Attract, retain, and develop top data talent while mentoring and training to foster growth and motivation within the team.
Task Prioritization: Collaborate with technical and business teams to understand their data needs and priorities, effectively communicating the value of data initiatives. Prioritize tasks and define the roadmap, balancing competing demands from different stakeholders.
Data Profiling: Analyze data types, relationships, patterns, and trends to enhance data understanding.
Requirements Definition: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to articulate clear, specific, and achievable data requirements, including how data should be presented for consumption.
Business Process Understanding: Grasp business workflows to make informed assumptions regarding sources, entities, and attributes that answer business questions.
Validation: Validate products with users to ensure they meet needs and expectations, leveraging data and metrics to inform decisions.
Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyze business and product performance using metrics and KPIs to assess success, tracking the effectiveness of data initiatives and investments, and using data-driven insights for continuous improvement.
Data Architecture & Infrastructure: Understand the technical architecture/infrastructure that supports the organization's data needs, including storage, integrations, and analytics platforms
Powered by AI: Support the incorporation of AI in team workflows to enhance performance.

Requirements for this challenge:
Experience with major Cloud Platform providers (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
Excellent level of English C1 or above
Experience with data platforms (Databricks or Snowflake)
Experience working with international clients
Strong strategic thinking and product mindset
Experience with value-based prioritization
Proven team leadership skills with a hands-on approach
 
Nice to Have:
Familiarity with AI engagements and Agentic coding
Experience in either the Data Platform, Data Visualization, or Advanced Analytics space
Experience with on-prem and data cloud migration 
Experience with project management tools 
Experience with AI/ML
Spanish communication (reading, writing, and speaking)

How You’ll Make an Impact: We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Fullstack Software Developer to join our development team at HCSS. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing scalable and robust Cloud-Native software solutions, primarily using .NET, to meet the complex requirements of our projects.
What Will You Be Doing?
Design, develop, and deploy .NET-based microservices on Cloud providers, following best practices for scalability, performance, and security.
Develop responsive and user-friendly frontend applications using the React framework, ensuring a seamless and engaging user experience.
Set up and maintain Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment processes, including infrastructure as code.
Integrate third-party APIs and services to enhance the functionality of our applications.
Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance and support to ensure the successful delivery of projects.
Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends, and incorporate them into our development processes as needed.
Requirements:
Advanced English skills, both written and verbal, to effectively communicate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Proven experience as a Senior Fullstack Developer, with strong expertise in .NET microservices and React or Angular frontend development.
Strong proficiency in the C# programming language and experience with ASP.NET Core or similar frameworks for building microservices.
Hands-on experience with the React framework and proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
In-depth knowledge of Cloud services, particularly Azure, and experience with deploying and managing applications on cloud infrastructure.
Solid understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and asynchronous messaging patterns.
Strong experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for setting up build pipelines and infrastructure as code.
Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
Familiarity with DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.
Bonus: Experience with Ruby would be a plus!
If you are a passionate and driven Senior Fullstack Developer looking to take your career to the next level with exciting projects in a fast-paced environment, we encourage you to apply today! We are looking forward to receiving your application and working together to drive our success.

vagas.descriptionPlain:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


We are looking for a Software Architect with strong expertise in .NET technologies and SQL to design, lead, and evolve scalable, high-performance software solutions. You will be the technical reference for development teams, driving architectural decisions, ensuring best practices, and bridging the gap between business needs and technical execution.
Requisitos:
Design and evolve scalable, secure, and high-performance software architectures aligned with business goals
Define architectural patterns, technical standards, and engineering best practices for .NET-based solutions
Lead the creation and maintenance of architectural documentation, including system diagrams, design decisions, and integration strategies
Conduct architecture reviews across squads, providing structured technical feedback
Drive the adoption of best practices in .NET Core / .NET 6+ development
Guide teams on C# advanced concepts: LINQ, async/await, generics, dependency injection, and design patterns
Define and enforce standards for RESTful API design and implementation
Support and mentor senior and mid-level developers, raising the overall technical bar of the team
Design and oversee relational database architectures using SQL Server or equivalent
Define standards for data modeling, query optimization, and transaction management
Ensure database performance, scalability, and integrity across environments
Evaluate and recommend strategies for data access patterns and ORM usage (e.g., Entity Framework
Architect integrations between internal and external systems, defining clear contracts and communication patterns
Define strategies for microservices, event-driven architecture, or SOA where applicable
Collaborate with DevOps teams to ensure solutions are cloud-ready (preferably Azure)
Contribute to CI/CD pipeline design and promote DevSecOps culture across teams
Proficiency in .NET Core / .NET 6+ and ASP.NET Core Web API
Advanced C# skills: LINQ, async/await, generics, reflection, and dependency injection
Strong knowledge of design patterns (SOLID, DDD, CQRS, Repository, Mediator)
Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems
Experience with Microsoft Azure or equivalent cloud platforms
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices
Inglês: Avançado
Diferenciais: 
Experience with event-driven architectures (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka)
Familiarity with GraphQL in .NET applications
Knowledge of Identity Server, JWT, OAuth 2.0
Experience with CQRS and MediatR patterns
Understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles
Exposure to Agile methodologies (Scrum / Kanban)
Familiarity with observability tools (Application Insights, Datadog, Grafana)

Responsabilidades:
Liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções FullStack utilizando .NET e Angular.
Supervisionar a leitura, validação e revisão crítica de código gerado automaticamente.
Implementar e orquestrar ferramentas de IA para desenvolvimento de software, como OpenAI APIs e GitHub Copilot.
Estruturar workflows de desenvolvimento orientados por IA, assegurando a qualidade e manutenibilidade do código.
Desenvolver APIs RESTful robustas e escaláveis em .NET.
Criar interfaces de usuário eficientes e responsivas utilizando Angular 19+.
Aplicar princípios de design de software (SOLID, KISS) para manter o código modular e reutilizável.
Implementar Design Patterns adequados para resolver problemas de arquitetura.
Realizar testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) para garantir a qualidade do software.
Gerenciar e otimizar bancos de dados relacionais, como PostgreSQL ou SQL Server.
Utilizar Docker e docker-compose para desenvolvimento e implementação de aplicações.
Monitorar sistemas com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, Grafana ou ELK.
Trabalhar com sistemas distribuídos e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Service Bus).
Colaborar em práticas de DevOps, preferencialmente em ambientes Azure.
Interagir com clientes em inglês (nível intermediário/avançado).
Requisitos:
Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor sênior.
Experiência prática com ferramentas de IA para desenvolvimento de software.
Habilidade em estruturar workflows de desenvolvimento orientados por IA.
Desenvolvimento backend com .NET (preferencialmente .NET 8+).
Desenvolvimento front-end com Angular 19+ e integração com APIs.
Aplicação de princípios SOLID e KISS.
Domínio de Design Patterns (Factory, Strategy, Builder, etc.).
Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários e integração).
Conhecimento em Docker e docker-compose.
Experiência com banco de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL ou SQL Server).
Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Service Bus).
Experiência com DevOps (Azure).
Diferenciais: 
Experiência em construção de agentes autônomos ou semi-autônomos.
Experiência com pipelines de desenvolvimento assistido por IA.
Conhecimento em ASP.NET e RPA.
Conhecimento em engenharia de prompts e avaliação de qualidade de outputs de modelos de IA.
Conhecimento em SAP.

At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


About the opportunity
We are looking for a Tech Lead/Architect (.NET + Azure) to join an international project. In this role, you will be the technical leader of the team: a highly experienced professional who guides technical direction, solves problems together with the team, and is able to implement solutions when needed. We want someone who enjoys sharing knowledge and contributing to CI&T and the community. We value cultural fit, respect for differences, collaboration, and teamwork.
 
What your day-to-day will look like
As the technical leader of the team, you will be responsible for:
Being an accessible technical reference for the developers, QA, and support teams, assisting and guiding them whenever they need support
Getting hands-on and implementing solutions when needed, especially when the team requires support to deliver changes
Leading the technical response to severe production incidents, from diagnosis to verified resolution
Guiding architectural and technical decisions, documenting the significant ones, to keep the solution scalable, secure, and sustainable
Solving complex problems together with the team, bringing the right people together to find the best solution
Reviewing technical solutions and promoting good programming and architecture practices
Helping keep the backlog well-defined and taking part in refinement sessions
Driving continuous improvements on an established solution
Keeping code quality and security findings visible and remediated within agreed SLAs
Defining and evolving technical standards
Following .NET and Azure trends and bringing in the ones that make sense for the project
Partnering with DevOps on application changes that affect operations
Communicating in English with the client’s technical experts when needed
Translating business needs into technical options and decisions
 
What you should have
Strong, in-depth experience in C# and modern .NET versions, including ASP.NET Core MVC Razor
Working knowledge of Azure and DevOps practices, enough to partner with DevOps on application changes that affect operations
High level of seniority, still hands-on and able to implement solutions
Experience in guiding teams and driving technical decisions
Proven ability to solve complex problems collaboratively, involving the right people and sharing the challenge with the team instead of working in isolation
Leadership soft skills to align people, encourage collaboration, and drive solutions together
Experience driving continuous improvements and technical standards
Experience with databases, version control, cloud, and CI/CD tools
Experience with automated testing, code review practices, and static analysis tools, including remediating code quality and security findings
Experience troubleshooting production issues and handling incidents
Good judgment to prioritize and to raise technical risks early
Experience or ability to work with development, QA, and support activities
Excellent communication skills, both technical and business-related, including clear written documentation
Advanced or fluent English

Responsabilidades:
Liderar tecnicamente a implementação Salesforce: configurações padrão, desenvolvimento personalizado (custom) e elementos de migração de dados
Definir arquitetura, padrões de codificação e boas práticas (orientação a objetos, MVC, Domain Layer)
Conduzir a gestão de releases e os padrões de implantação (deployment) do projeto
Realizar revisões de código dos desenvolvedores e aprovar a documentação técnica do time
Interagir diretamente com o time global da Syngenta e com as equipes de produto da Salesforce, alinhando requisitos, arquitetura e prioridades entre regiões
Orientar tecnicamente a equipe de desenvolvimento e apoiar o onboarding de novos integrantes
Domínio de código-fonte, versionamento e padrões de implantação
Entender o projeto de ponta a ponta e depurar/resolver problemas complexos
Monitorar a saúde do ambiente e validar as entregas pós-deploy (smoke tests)
Atuar em ambiente ágil, colaborativo e distribuído (multi-região), seguindo nossa metodologia
Habilidades Necessárias:
Inglês avançado/fluente (mandatório) — comunicação técnica, reuniões e documentação com o time global da Syngenta
Conhecimento em Experience Cloud (prioritário) e em Service ou Sales Cloud
Desenvolvimento programático (Apex, LWC, JavaScript) e declarativo (point and click), com forte ênfase em customização
Conhecimento em versionamento de código e em práticas/estratégias de implantação do Salesforce
Conceitos de orientação a objetos e entendimento da arquitetura MVC
Integrações: APIs (REST, SOAP), ETL, Web Services
Conhecimento básico de RDBMS
Fortes habilidades analíticas e raciocínio lógico
Capacidade de liderança técnica e condução de equipe
Diferencial:
Certificações Salesforce (Platform Developer, Experience Cloud Consultant, entre outras)
Conhecimento em Commerce Cloud (B2B Commerce) — dado o contexto e-commerce/B2B
Habilidades para levantamento de requisitos e desenho de solução na plataforma
Conhecimentos de CRM

About the opportunity
Join CI&T to help a global medical technology company design and scale its next generation of AI solutions across Latin America. You’ll be part of a regional AI team, working where business strategy, AI engineering, software architecture, data and cloud meet. Your job is to turn real business challenges into secure, responsible, production-ready AI solutions.
This is a hands-on architecture role. It suits someone who enjoys digging into business problems, experimenting with emerging AI technologies, and working with engineers and stakeholders to take solutions from idea to production.
What you’ll do
-Design end-to-end AI solutions: Generative AI applications, LLM-powered workflows, intelligent agents, RAG solutions, virtual assistants and intelligent automation.
-Turn business requirements into practical technical architectures, choosing the right models, services, data sources, integrations and infrastructure.
-Build and validate prototypes and proofs of concept to test feasibility, business value and architectural options.
-Work with AI engineers, software engineers, data scientists and data engineers to take solutions from prototype to production.
-Design agentic solutions, including tool calling, orchestration, memory, retrieval and human-in-the-loop patterns.
-Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, vector databases and cloud services.
-Build reusable AI components, services, APIs and architectural patterns that serve several business use cases.
-Evaluate and recommend AI models, frameworks and platforms, weighing performance, scalability, security and cost.
-Build Responsible AI, security, privacy and compliance into every design, working with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy and Quality teams.
-Help set up evaluation, monitoring, observability and LLMOps practices for AI solutions in production.
-Document architectures, technical decisions, integration patterns and implementation guidance.
-Keep up with developments in Generative AI, agentic AI and cloud AI platforms, and spot where they can solve meaningful problems.
What we’re looking for
-Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Data Science, AI or a related field, or equivalent experience.
6+ years in software engineering, solution or cloud engineering, data/AI engineering or solution architecture.
-Hands-on experience designing and building AI/ML or Generative AI solutions.
-Solid working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search and AI agents.
-Experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
-Experience designing and integrating APIs, microservices and cloud-native applications.
-Strong Python skills, and the ability to build prototypes and reference implementations.
-Good command of engineering practices: version control, testing, CI/CD and DevOps.
-Awareness of AI security, data privacy, Responsible AI and governance in enterprise settings.
-Strong analytical skills, with the ability to weigh technical trade-offs and explain them clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
-Experience working with multidisciplinary, distributed teams.
-Fluent English (written and spoken) and Spanish.
Nice to have
-Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock or similar enterprise GenAI platforms.
-Agent and orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen or CrewAI.
-End-to-end RAG implementation: document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval strategies and evaluation.
-Azure AI Search or other vector database / enterprise search technologies.
LLMOps: model and prompt evaluation, tracing, monitoring and lifecycle management.
-Modern data platforms such as Snowflake.
-Containers, Kubernetes and infrastructure as code.
-Experience in healthcare, life sciences, MedTech, financial services or other regulated industries.
-Cloud, AI or architecture certifications (Microsoft, AWS or equivalent).
Portuguese is a plus.
Why CI&T
-Work on AI solutions that reach production in a regulated, high-impact industry.
-Collaborate with global teams and a client that is investing in scaling AI responsibly.
-Grow toward ownership of architecture decisions and reusable AI standards.
-Join a company that puts AI at the center of how it delivers technology.

Senior Cybersecurity Architect & Operations Specialist

We accept candidates from Brazil and Colombia.

Work model: 100% Remote
Working hours: Business hours, aligned with US-based stakeholders

The Senior Cybersecurity Architect & Operations Specialist will lead the evolution, optimization, and operational effectiveness of cybersecurity services for a US-based organization. This role combines security architecture, security operations leadership, incident response, threat intelligence, and third-party service management.

Working closely with executive stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams, this professional will serve as a senior technical leader, ensuring that security technologies, service providers, and operational processes work together effectively to protect the organization's environment, manage cyber risks, and meet applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.

This position reports directly to the organization's Head of Security and works in close partnership with other cybersecurity leaders across the security program.

This position requires fluent English, as you will interact daily with US-based stakeholders and participate in technical discussions and executive-level meetings.

Your Main Activities

  • Cybersecurity Operations Leadership & Optimization: Lead the continuous improvement of the cybersecurity operations function, ensuring that security monitoring, detection, investigation, escalation, and response capabilities are effective, integrated, and aligned with business priorities. Identify operational gaps, improve processes, and drive initiatives that strengthen the organization's security posture.

  • Security Architecture & Technology Management: Evaluate and optimize the architecture, configuration, integration, and effectiveness of security technologies and services across the environment. Ensure that security capabilities are properly implemented, monitored, maintained, and continuously improved, maximizing their effectiveness and value.

  • Third-Party Service Management: Coordinate and oversee external cybersecurity service providers, ensuring clear responsibilities, effective collaboration, service quality, and alignment with operational requirements. Consolidate activities across multiple providers, manage dependencies, monitor performance, and drive accountability for service delivery and continuous improvement.

  • Security Incident Management & Escalation: Act as the senior escalation point during business hours for significant security alerts, complex investigations, and cybersecurity incidents. Coordinate incident response activities, guide technical investigations, support containment and remediation decisions, and ensure appropriate communication, documentation, and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.

  • Security Monitoring & Detection Engineering: Oversee the effectiveness of security monitoring and detection capabilities, including SIEM, endpoint security, network security, identity, and cloud security. Drive improvements in log coverage, detection rules, alert prioritization, correlation, and response workflows to reduce false positives, improve visibility, and accelerate incident handling.

  • Threat Intelligence & Proactive Defense: Lead threat intelligence activities by evaluating emerging threats, relevant threat actors, attack techniques, and vulnerabilities that may affect the organization. Translate intelligence into actionable recommendations, detection improvements, preventive controls, and defensive strategies tailored to the organization's risk profile.

  • Security Projects & Continuous Improvement: Lead security-related projects, technology implementations, integrations, upgrades, and operational changes. Define priorities, coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and ensure that initiatives deliver measurable improvements to security capabilities and operational maturity.

  • Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management: Present security posture, operational performance, significant incidents, emerging threats, risks, and improvement initiatives to senior stakeholders. Translate complex technical information into clear business implications, actionable recommendations, and prioritized decisions.

  • AI-Driven Security Operations: Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve operational efficiency, accelerate investigations, streamline reporting, reduce repetitive work, and enhance security analysis, while maintaining appropriate security, privacy, and governance controls.

You Need to Have Experience With

  • Significant experience in cybersecurity, with a strong background in security architecture, security operations, or a combination of both.

  • Proven experience leading cybersecurity initiatives, coordinating technical teams, and managing third-party security service providers.

  • Strong understanding of SOC operating models, including security monitoring, alert triage, investigation, incident escalation, and incident response processes.

  • Hands-on knowledge of security technologies and their integration, configuration, monitoring, and optimization, particularly SIEM, EDR, network security, and cloud security capabilities.

  • Experience managing complex security incidents, coordinating investigations, supporting containment and remediation, and communicating findings and recommendations to stakeholders.

  • Experience with threat intelligence, threat detection, security monitoring improvements, and proactive defense strategies.

  • Ability to assess security architecture and operational processes, identify gaps, and translate findings into practical technical and organizational improvements.

  • Experience leading security projects, implementations, integrations, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Excellent communication, leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to make informed decisions under pressure.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

  • Fluent English, including the ability to lead meetings, discuss complex security topics, and deliver executive-level presentations.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and collaborate effectively across geographically distributed teams.

  • Experience with Microsoft Sentinel or other SIEM platforms, EDR solutions, endpoint protection, identity security, network security, VPN, DNS security, and related technologies.

You Will Stand Out If You Have Any of These

  • Experience in the healthcare, medical device, or other regulated industries.

  • Experience supporting US-based organizations and working directly with executive stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with healthcare-related regulatory and security frameworks, such as HIPAA and HITRUST, as well as NIST Cybersecurity Framework and ISO 27001.

  • Experience with AWS security services and cloud security architecture.

  • Understanding of cybersecurity risk management, operational controls, and applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.

  • Experience improving SOC efficiency through automation, orchestration, and security operations use cases.

  • Practical experience using AI tools or implementing AI-enabled solutions to improve cybersecurity operations, threat analysis, incident investigation, or reporting.

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, GIAC certifications, or equivalent credentials.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
